metadata.name: Run History
metadata.description:
[h1]Run History / 对局记录[/h1] Records your last 20 runs and shows them on a page styled like the game's own paper menus. (中文说明在下面)
[h1]Required: REPENTOGON 1.0.12e[/h1] [b]This mod needs REPENTOGON version 1.0.12e. Install it before using the mod.[/b]
[table] [tr][th]Item[/th][th]Needed?[/th][th]Notes[/th][/tr] [tr][td]Repentance DLC, game v1.7.9b[/td][td][b]Required[/b][/td][td]The game version this mod is made for.[/td][/tr] [tr][td]REPENTOGON [b]1.0.12e[/b] (exactly this version)[/td][td][b]Required[/b][/td][td]Newer REPENTOGON versions only work on Repentance+ and will not work here.[/td][/tr] [tr][td]Repentance+[/td][td]Not supported[/td][td]Not tested.[/td][/tr] [tr][td]Afterbirth+ or older[/td][td]Not supported[/td][td]Needs Repentance.[/td][/tr] [tr][td]External Item Descriptions (EID)[/td][td]Optional[/td][td]Only for names of enemies and bosses added by other mods.[/td][/tr] [/table]
[b]Do not use the REPENTOGON item on the Steam Workshop.[/b] It is the newest version, made for Repentance+ only, and subscribing to it does not install it. Version 1.0.12e is only available on GitHub.
[h2]How to install REPENTOGON 1.0.12e[/h2] [olist] [*]Open the [url=https://github.com/TeamREPENTOGON/REPENTOGON/releases/tag/1.0.12e]REPENTOGON 1.0.12e release page[/url]. Under "Assets", download [b]REPENTOGON.zip[/b]. [*]Open the game folder: in your Steam Library, right-click [i]The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth[/i] → Manage → Browse local files. It is the folder that contains [b]isaac-ng.exe[/b]. [*]Extract [b]everything[/b] in REPENTOGON.zip into that folder. If Windows asks about replacing files, choose replace. [*]Start the game from Steam. On the first start a REPENTOGON updater may appear, or the game may close by itself. [b]Do not install anything the updater offers[/b] (it installs the Repentance+ version). [*]In the game folder, open [b]dsound.ini[/b] with Notepad and make sure it says [b]CheckForUpdates = 0[/b]. Save it. [*]Start the game again. When it works, the game window title reads [b]"The Binding of Isaac: Repentance (+ REPENTOGON 1.0.12e)"[/b]. [*]Subscribe to this mod. Done. [/olist] If REPENTOGON is missing, the history page shows a red "Needs REPENTOGON 1.0.12e" next to its title. To remove REPENTOGON later, delete [b]dsound.dll[/b] from the game folder.
[h2]How to open the history[/h2] [list] [*]Main menu: press [b]F2[/b] on any screen, or open the Stats screen and pick the "Run History" note in the top right [*]During a run: press [b]F2[/b] (change the key in rh_config.lua) [*]In the floor view, press [b]Space[/b] to browse items and see their names and pickup text [/list]
[h2]What it records[/h2] [b]Every run[/b] [list] [*]Character, seed, difficulty, result (win / death / quit), run time [*]Final items, final active items and trinkets, final stats [*]The last boss you beat [*]What killed you (enemy or boss with its death-screen portrait, or spikes, curse doors, self-damage...) [/list] [b]Every floor[/b] [list] [*]Items picked up, bosses beaten (with icons), time spent [*]Coins, bombs and keys when you left the floor [*]Whether a devil / angel room appeared and whether you went in [/list]
[h2]Notes[/h2] [list] [*]English and Chinese UI, following the game's language. Other languages show English. [*]History is saved per save slot in data/run history/ and is not synced by Steam Cloud. Runs played before you installed the mod can't be recorded. [*]Opening the page during a run stops your character, but enemies keep moving. Open it in a cleared room. [*]Stats, active items and trinkets are recorded for player 1 only. [*]Greed mode records only the final Ultra Greed, not the wave bosses. [/list]
[h1]对局记录[/h1] 自动记录最近 20 局对局，用游戏自己的纸张菜单风格显示。
[h1]必须安装：REPENTOGON 1.0.12e[/h1] [b]本 mod 需要 REPENTOGON 1.0.12e 版本，请先安装再使用。[/b]
[table] [tr][th]项目[/th][th]是否需要[/th][th]说明[/th][/tr] [tr][td]忏悔 DLC，游戏版本 v1.7.9b[/td][td][b]必需[/b][/td][td]mod 就是为这个版本做的[/td][/tr] [tr][td]REPENTOGON [b]1.0.12e[/b]（必须是这个版本）[/td][td][b]必需[/b][/td][td]更新的 REPENTOGON 只支持忏悔+，在这里用不了[/td][/tr] [tr][td]忏悔+[/td][td]不支持[/td][td]没有测试过[/td][/tr] [tr][td]胎衣+ 及更早版本[/td][td]不支持[/td][td]需要忏悔[/td][/tr] [tr][td]EID（External Item Descriptions）[/td][td]可选[/td][td]只用于显示其他 mod 加入的敌人和 Boss 的名字[/td][/tr] [/table]
[b]不要用创意工坊里的 REPENTOGON。[/b]那是最新版，只支持忏悔+，而且订阅并不会安装它。1.0.12e 只能在 GitHub 下载。
[h2]REPENTOGON 1.0.12e 安装步骤[/h2] [olist] [*]打开 [url=https://github.com/TeamREPENTOGON/REPENTOGON/releases/tag/1.0.12e]REPENTOGON 1.0.12e 发布页[/url]，在"Assets"下面下载 [b]REPENTOGON.zip[/b] [*]打开游戏目录：在 Steam 库里右键《以撒的结合：重生》→ 管理 → 浏览本地文件，也就是有 [b]isaac-ng.exe[/b] 的那个文件夹 [*]把 REPENTOGON.zip 里的[b]全部文件[/b]解压到这个文件夹；Windows 问是否替换时选替换 [*]从 Steam 启动游戏。第一次启动时可能会弹出 REPENTOGON 的更新程序，或者游戏自己关掉。[b]不要安装更新程序提供的任何东西[/b]（它装的是忏悔+ 用的版本） [*]用记事本打开游戏目录里的 [b]dsound.ini[/b]，确认写的是 [b]CheckForUpdates = 0[/b]，保存 [*]再启动游戏。装好后游戏窗口标题会显示 [b]"The Binding of Isaac: Repentance (+ REPENTOGON 1.0.12e)"[/b] [*]订阅本 mod，完成 [/olist] 没装好时，记录页面标题旁边会显示红字"需要 REPENTOGON 1.0.12e"。 以后想卸载 REPENTOGON：删掉游戏目录里的 [b]dsound.dll[/b] 即可。
[h2]怎么打开记录[/h2] [list] [*]主菜单：任意界面按 [b]F2[/b]，或者进入"统计数据"选右上角的"对局记录"便签 [*]对局中：按 [b]F2[/b]（按键可在 rh_config.lua 里修改） [*]在楼层详情页按 [b]空格[/b] 逐个查看道具的官方名称和拾取说明 [/list]
[h2]记录内容[/h2] [b]每局[/b]：角色、种子、难度、结果（胜利 / 死亡 / 放弃）、用时；最终道具、最后的主动道具和饰品、最终属性；最后击败的 Boss；死因（敌人或 Boss 的死亡画面头像，或尖刺、诅咒房门、自伤等）。 [b]每层[/b]：获得的道具、击败的 Boss（带图标）、本层用时、离开时的金币 / 炸弹 / 钥匙、恶魔房 / 天使房是否出现、是否进入。
[h2]说明[/h2] [list] [*]界面有中文和英文，跟随游戏语言；其他语言显示英文 [*]记录按存档槽分开保存在 data/run history/，不走 Steam 云同步；安装 mod 之前打的对局无法记录 [*]对局内打开页面时角色不会动，但敌人不会暂停，建议在清完的房间里看 [*]属性、主动和饰品只记录 1 号角色 [*]贪婪模式只记录最后的究极贪婪，不记录每波的 Boss [/list]
